features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Insight, Nature, or Survival (your choice).

features.name: Coordinated Fighting
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, on your first attack each round, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls if at least one friendly creature is within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Move As One
features.description:
At 3rd level, at any point while moving on your turn, you can command up to proficiency bonus willing friendly creatures within 5 feet to use a reaction to move up to their speed alongside you (remaining within 5 ft). This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

features.name: Massed Fighting
features.description:
Starting at 7th level, on your first attack each round, gain +1 to attack and damage rolls per friendly creature within 5 ft (max bonus equal to proficiency bonus).

When you use Action Surge, each friendly creature within 15 ft (except you) gains +2 AC and +2 to DEX saves for 1 minute.

features.name: Vigilance
features.description: At 10th level, when a friendly creature you can see is reduced to 0 HP, you can use your reaction to move up to your speed toward it. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

payload.name: Vigilance
payload.description: When a friendly creature you can see drops to 0 HP, move up to your speed toward it (no opportunity attacks).

features.name: Tactical Positioning
features.description: At 15th level, moving through a hostile creature's space is not difficult terrain for you, and you can move through a hostile creature's space even if it is only one size larger or smaller than you. You still can't end your move in a hostile creature's space.

features.name: Cooperative Strike
features.description: Starting at 18th level, when you use the Attack action with a weapon while at least one friendly creature is within 5 feet, you can use a bonus action to make one additional attack with that weapon.
